items.text: “Better late than never.” That's what they say, especially when they are just me, Ben, the weirdo at the helm of Times & Galaxy’s development.

[p align="start"]It’s been light years, but Patch 6 is here. It's pretty dull and utilitarian. We set to work unclogging some nasty code drains and gassing some persistent, pesky bugs hiding in the darker corners of the Scanner. This is why we are calling it the Janitorbot Patch. We want our game squeaky clean!
[p align="start"]The most notable fixes?
[p align="start"]A handful of rare but consistent softlocks in dialogue have been addressed in multiple levels:
[p align="start"]on the ship after talking to the Mechanic in Cycle 6
[p align="start"]during a conversation about Oren’s bully in Cycle 13
[p align="start"]in conversation with Arwin during Cycle 15
[p align="start"]on the Barley’s haunted farm when talking to Leep Jr. or initially refusing the implant

[p align="start"]and when first entering the Silly Cube recall press conference if you somehow sneaked around our clever level design and interacted manually with a character before triggering the intro.
[p align="start"]In addition to a handful of smaller fixes, various typos have been caught and killed (RIP typos; you will not be missed).
Most of the bugs fixed in the patch were caught by players who reported them to us via the forum, Fellow Traveller Discord, or e-mail. I can’t thank you enough.

[p align="start"]There's still one more patch in the works, something more substantive. Details to come, but it’s my intention for this last patch to be a doozy. And to release it some time before the world ends. Ideally well before then.
[p align="start"]Thank you for your commitment to space journalism.
[p align="start"]Ben
This is Patch 5 already. Times flies like a spaceship. Fast. Time moves fast.

In this patch, which we are calling the 'Copybot' Patch, we focused heavily on some key issues reported by players and scores of polish. There are still some known issues to be patched in (we are working on them as you read this probably).

Highlights of the Copybot Patch include fixing a scripting issue that was making it impossible to unlock the Gearheaded Gourmand achievement/trophy. To unlock it, you must: eat the cat treats at the cat show; drink Nitro-chug at the robo fights; eat glowing veggies or mushrooms at the dirt fair; and drink both oil and coffee from a machine on the Scanner. If you have done all of these in a single playthrough, drink coffee on the Scanner to unlock.
To see a list of fixes and issues we are currently working to fix, click here.

We are continuing to work hard to polish this game until it shines like a flying saucer. Thank you for playing and for your patience. If you like Times & Galaxy, please consider recommending it to a friend. A weird lil game like ours needs to find its weird lil audience.
Keep watching the skis,
Ben

Thank you for playing Times & Galaxy. Since release we have been gathering bug reports from players who have encountered issues we didn't catch prior to release. This first post-launch patch is focused on making sure the game is running smoothly without any major speed bumps. We've addressed some significant issues found including fixes to the Scanner Map, logic gating a couple conversations and achievements. The patch also fixes any reported issues that have softlocked players’ games or, in a couple super nasty cases, eaten saves.

We continue to work on bug fixes and text/art polish. Thank you for your patience as we make this game as squeaky clean as possible. If you encounter an issue, please report it on the game's Steam Community discussion forum in the pinned bugs thread. If you prefer you can email: support@fellowtraveller.games. ❤️
Ben

notes.title: Key Fixes in the Mechanic Patch

items.text: Fixes softlock in Cycle 12 Arwin conversation where option pointed to nothing, stopping the player from progressing.
Fixes issue that preventEd players from accepting their story and progressing beyond the Scanner in Cycle 15 if they first asked Arwin about their performance.
Changes Garden Achievement to unlock when all seeds have been planted, rather than when all plants have reached maturity.
Updates Scanner map to better reflect which characters are in which rooms on any given cycle; also fixes input related bugs that were affecting the map user experience.
Fixes Readership and Reputation achievement unlocks in final Cycle. Players with high numbers in both were receiving achievements for doing badly.
Adds background audio missing from Toy Recall mission.
Fixes lost sprite reference when loading saves.
Updates conditionals in Copybot conversations that were preventing players from romancing them.
Updates Arwin's Cycle 7 conversation so players now can hear about the story assignments before committing to one.
Fixes issue with Billy’s collider in Cycle 17. It should no longer be possible to trigger his conversation manually before the proximity trigger fires.
Fixes Copybot ending collider with similar issue to Billy’s.
Updates SFX playback method to detach it from animations for easier polish in future updates
Sets Humania to the correct size in story intro animation
Polishes text in several story builder elements, notably in Cycle 10
Howdy Reporterbots!

I've just pushed a significant update to the Times & Galaxy demo. The update focuses on bug fixes and general stability, especially around the save/load system as well as the behavior of characters when you leave and return to the game. A few players reported some funky behavior from characters, especially on the Scanner and in the Cat Show, where they would move to previous positions and repeat lines if you exited out and then continued to play. These issues should be fixed now (knock on space-wood).
When you update, make sure your version number in the top left corner of the main menu reads 0.10.3500.

It's best practice to start a new game and not try to continue your save from the previous demo version. It might work fine, but yeah, it's been a while since we updated the demo and this may introduce weird bugs that could otherwise be avoided.
If you encounter any other issues on this version of the demo, please hop into the bug reporting thread on our Steam forum and let us know what broke and what you were doing when it broke.
Excited to show you all more very soon. For now, if you've put off playing the demo, now is a great time to jump in and see what our weird game is all about.
Thanks for your support and tell five friends about our game before sundown or you'll be cursed!*
Ben
*Note: Curse is for entertainment purposes only.
Hey fellow spacehacks!
I've just pushed an update!
In DEMO VERSION 0.8.2876 we have fixed a few bugs that I'm sure will help smooth out players' early experience a bit.

Continuing After Finishing Demo: If you complete the demo, you are no longer able to select Continue. You'll need to start a new game. This is to prevent a bug that was taking players back to a save before the demo end slide, breaking all sorts of conditionals. In the main release, you'll have multiple save slots so you can create multiple characters and save scum to your heart's content.

UI Breaking When Swapping Between Controller/Keyboard: In the previous demo build, when you swapped between controller and keyboard in the middle of gameplay, UI would fail to recognize the switch and show keyboard controls always. This should no longer happen with version 0.8.2876.

Volume Sliders: Volume was "aggressive" in its sliders, going to basically zero volume when you got halfway. Users obviously expect the slider to go from 0 to 100, not -100 to 100, even if the game was still playing sounds that no human ears can detect (kidding). This is fixed too.

Additionally, you now have the option to use spacebar when confirming conversation options and submitting stories. People love spacebar. And our game is about space. It only made sense to put it to better use, especially for WASD + Mouse faithful.
Ben
